strings.en: Good work. That was a tough one...
Yes... In all our long fighting, we've never faced an enemy that big...
No matter how big the enemy, once we got inside,
it wasn't much different from usual.
No foe can stand against a Tsurugi... I let the others rest, Captain.
Understood. ...It can't be helped.
The ones who came up from the surface especially had no time to rest.
...Open a channel to the Elshank and the Nadesico.
Yes, sir.
Hm? Where's Dr. Kasshu?
Ah, he went to meet Domon. A long-awaited reunion...
We're connected? Princess Romina, Captain Misumaru... Hm?
You're the first officer, Aoi... right?
Y-yes! Captain Bright,
...Captain Misumaru is currently away on, um, important ship business...
Oh my... Has some trouble arisen on the Nadesico?
If there's anything we can do...
No, no, it's nothing so serious, I assure you...
...It seems we'd be better off not asking why...
Be honest: she wanted a confession like Rain got, so she went to
barge in on Tenkawa. I think it's better to just say so.
Sigh...
So, Bright, you had something about our next steps?
Ahem... Right. About our future course...
I'm thinking of moving Londo Bell's flagship to the Elshank.
Oh my...
Now that's a big decision.
...The Elshank and the Nadesico, and the Ra Cailum...
Indeed, the Ra Cailum lacks something.
Lacks something...? ...I see, jump travel.
Hmm...
Having the whole fleet held back by one ship is hardly ideal.
It's a shame to lose the Ra Cailum's combat power, though...
The Elshank's micro-worm drive, the Nadesico's Boson Jump...
Indeed.
On that point, Federation warships can't keep up...
Yes.
We can't always rely on Dr. Tarsan.
I'd like to return to Von Braun once to make the transfer, but...
What do you think, Princess Romina?
Yes, I'd be delighted to welcome you all.
Jeez. After monster hunting, now we're moving house.
Tetsuya, it's necessary!
First Officer Aoi, this doesn't directly concern the Nadesico, but
please report it to Captain Misumaru.
Yes, sir, understood!
All right, all ships, set course for Von Braun.
You okay, Rain? Don't push yourself too hard...
Come on, Domon, don't worry so much. I'm fine now...
Well, well, showing off for us, huh...
Now, now, don't be jealous. He's only just managed to confess.
Hmph... I thought him still a fledgling in matters of love...
but it seems he's found himself a fine girl...
But at this rate, he'll be henpecked in no time.
Geez, you've got no sense of romance...
Someday, I'd like to get a confession like that too...
Huh? You say something, Lenny?
...! Geez, Joe, you idiot! ...Oh, that's...
...Domon...
...F... Father... Father!
Dr. Kasshu...
...Domon, well done... You stopped the Devil Gundam...
No, Father... it's because everyone lent me their strength.
Waaah, Kabuto!
I'm a sucker for these touching reunions!
C'mon, Boss, a guy your age crying... *sniff*
*Sniff* You're crying too, Kabuto!
Anyway... all that hard work paid off.
It sure did.
Yes... A father, huh...
Father... Mother...
Princess...
Geez, is being moved contagious or something?
Dad this, Dad that... Ugh...!?
Hey! Pai! Why do you always... Huh?
What's wrong, Pai? Upset stomach?
N-nothing!
(Dad... Father...? What's... Bari... as...?)
Rain. Don't worry about Mikamura. He was merely led astray.
The Neo Japan authorities understand that as well.
Yes...
And you must be Schwarz... I've heard about you too.
Do you... have no intention of removing that mask?
...None. I am Schwarz Bruder.
As long as there is war in the Earth Sphere, that will not change.
Now, I take my leave...
Schwarz!
It's all right, Domon...
Someday, the day may come when he removes that mask.
But that is for him to decide.
Schwarz......
Anyway, as far as the Devil Gundam goes, all's well that ends well.
As far as the Devil Gundam goes, anyway...
That's right... There are still plenty of enemy forces left.
No sweat! We just smash 'em like we did the Gaizok!
Being spirited is fine, but...
the ones still around have been building up their strength all this time.
And here we are, wiped out from nonstop fighting...
Yes. The battles ahead will be harder than ever.
Don't make that face! Let's do our best, Brother.
We gotta kick those Gyandlar guys off Earth fast, too!
Domon, about what comes next...
I know, Father.
We beat the Devil Gundam... but the Earth Sphere is still in this state.
I'll fight...!
Yes, that's best.
Put your strength to good use for all those who've helped you.
I'm coming with you... Domon.
According to Captain Bright, this ship is headed for Von Braun.
I'll recuperate there for a while.
Rebuilding the Neo Japan colony will take time, it seems.
Got it.
From what he said, we're going back to the Moon again.
That's right.
It's a big port, so it's probably handy in many ways.
I hope we can relax a little.
Yep, gotta rest up some, or we'll fall apart.
So naive,
like Captain Bright would ever give us that kind of free time.
Yeah. Even with free time, he'd have us tidying up gear or something.
Nah, just slack off on the chores!
Tidying up's no big deal. It's not like we're moving house.
Oh, then I'll do that too!
Hyoma, stop saying weird stuff!
People will think the whole Combattler team are slackers!
O-okay, okay... Don't get so mad...
Lady Haman, I believe the time is nearly right.
Major Anavel Gato... Don't be so hasty.
...Surely you haven't forgotten the failure of Operation Stardust?
Yes. Underestimating Londo Bell's strength was my own blunder...!
It's not as if I have no next move...
We've waited this long. Surely you can wait a little longer?
...Understood.
Lady Haman, you summoned me?
You've come, Mashymre.
Yes.
My failure in the Gate of Zedan operation... I deeply apologize.
What's done is done... Make up for it next time.
Yes... Lady Haman.
I've already made my move. That will be your chance to clear your name.
Together with Major Gato... understood?
Yes, ma'am!
(Her next move...)
Welcome, everyone.
We are honored to have you aboard the Elshank...
No need for stiff greetings, Princess!
Been a while since we met face-to-face, but you look well!
Yes, and I'm so glad to see you looking well too, Koji...
You bet!
Geez, you always get so pumped around a pretty girl!
Seriously! Honestly, Koji.
Wh-what's with you two?
...You've still got a lot to learn in this department, Koji.
Ahem...
From now on, the Elshank will be Londo Bell's flagship.
Oh yeah, that was the plan, huh.
With the Elshank's wormhole drive, getting around will be easier.
I am all but an amateur when it comes to battle...
So I ask that you take command, Captain Bright.
Understood. ...Which means,
who commanded your battles on the way here from the Schema system?
...That is...
Tch. Captain, drop it!
There's a lot to it, a whole lot!
It seems... that's something we shouldn't have asked.
(...Ilbora...)
We're off, huh...
Hmm, no matter how often I see them, those sparkly glimmers are so pretty.
I keep telling you, those are stars, Cham.
Huh...? Show... something's coming! That's not a glimmer or a star!
It's true, something's...
What?
Hear me, people of Earth. Hear me, people of Earth...
What? More aliens?
What...!?
Captain! A signal at two o'clock. Putting it on the monitor.
Big Bro, there's a person floating out there!
A person...!? We're in space!
Hear me, people of Earth... Hear me, people of Earth...
My name is... Deus.
Deus...? I've never heard that name. Who are you?
H-how can you all be so calm?
In outer space... and clearly without a suit!?
Mmm, I guess we're just used to surprises...
Someone's already hogged plenty of big moments doing just that.
I come... as an envoy from planet Campbell, 340,000 light-years away.
Planet Campbell!?
...Is that true!? Campbell...
Anyway, let's hear what Deus has to say!
The warlike faction that long ruled Campbell has been driven out...
and order has been restored under us pacifists...
...Pacifists, huh.
So not all the Campbellians were bad guys?
To the people of Earth, who suffered disaster at the hands of
the wicked Campbellians, I offer my deepest apologies...
Seriously, what a nuisance it was.
Ah, who cares?
We won't be bothered by the Campbellians anymore, right?
...However, though our planet Campbell is now at peace...
here, Empress Janera and her subordinates still remain...
General Dangel and Supreme Leader Warukimedes.
Empress Janera!? ...If we beat her...!
...there'll be no more Campbellians targeting Earth?
Precisely...
But I lack the power to defeat the Empress...
In that case, leave it to us.
But Tetsuya, we don't know where this Empress is, do we!?
Friend from a distant world, the Empress of Campbell...
Have you any information on Janera's whereabouts?
You do not appear to be from Earth... Your name?
Rom Stol.
Tenku Chushin Ken... one with ties to planet Cronos...!
Huh, looks like you're famous.
...Empress Janera is at what you call Lagrange point L3...
L3... that means Side 7.
Captain, it's true. Somewhere in Side 7 space, Minovsky density
has risen to extreme levels.
All right! If that's settled, hide-and-seek is over...!
Yeah, let's go take her down quick!
No running off on your own, Hyoma.
Our enemies ain't just the Campbellians, y'know.
That's right.
I wish you luck... friends of Earth...
Huh!? That big old guy went off somewhere!
Is that all right, Bright?
Well, since we couldn't track him, there's nothing we can do.
That was surprising... What will you do, Captain Bright?
Yes, Londo Bell's next move...
...A messenger of peace from planet Campbell... Can we trust that?
If we defeat Empress Janera...
there'll be no more evil Campbellians, he said, right?
If that Empress is at Green Oasis, then it should be true, right?
Side 7, hm...
What about the enemies besides Campbell?
For now, Neo Zeon seems to be the one to watch...
Those guys kept their heads down in the Devil Colony fight and before.
They must be building up their strength.
The Nu Gundam's in good shape. ...I can go anytime, Bright.
Captain! This is bad!
What is it? What happened?
ID codes... Delaz's fleet is on the move!
Hoh... Speak of the devil.
And... the Neo Zeon fleet as well!
Where are they headed!?
Fa, can you tell where on the Moon the Delaz Fleet is headed?
Fifth Luna!
What do you think, Amuro?
Haman and Fifth Luna... I don't see the connection.
It may be a diversion.
Nah, the big boss Haman as a diversion? No way, right?
Could be they want us to think that...
...Captain, I'd like to go to the Dark Zone...
Hm? Is something there?
On the way to Fifth Luna is fine... I'd like us to stop by.
All right, but only if we have time.
Let's sortie. We're out of time, Bright!
Please contact the Nadesico as well.
Understood.
Huh? Come to think of it, what happened to Captain Quattro?
Oh, he said he had some business to take care of.
Huh, that's unusual.
Yes, it's all fine. Things are proceeding smoothly... Colonel.
Understood. I'm counting on you...
